正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。 前提・単位・境界 無次元[-.5,.5]²、γ=5/3、ρ0=1、内向き速度1、p0=0、T=.6、衝撃半径.2。初期保存量はセル中心の冷たい状態の標本で、初期運動量の厳密セル平均ではありません。全4辺へρ=1+t/r、u=(-x/r,-y/r)の超音速流入を与え、対称境界・半径方向への射影・幾何源は使いません。 採用した計算法 区分定数のRusanov流束をx/y両方向の共有面に置く非分割更新とSSPRK2（Heun）です。CFL=.35を(max a_x+max a_y)/Δxに適用。外辺の冷たい物理流束は面内で解析積分し、時間に一次の流入をHeunの両段で積分します。セル平均の修復・圧力floor・seed・隠れた時間刻み再試行はなく、不正なRK段は配列を保存して失敗にします。 sinθによる64点Gauss求積で評価、128点との差と全質量の解析式で確認します。閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。128²で密度全域L1=.09981、原点込みcore L1=.12231、衝撃位置は軸.968セル・対角1.469セルの誤差。離散収支の最大相対残差は約4.6e-15です。D4の鏡映・座標交換の保存量偶奇性と、連続回転対称性を区別して測ります。 確認の限界と失敗条件 空間一次の軽量例で、原点過熱と衝撃層の誤差が残ります。最細格子でも中心最大比内部エネルギーは厳密値より約14%高いままです。軸・対角の衝撃半径差は約.501Δxで、3格子間で単調には減りません。D4偶奇性が丸め誤差でも円対称性が厳密という意味ではありません。一般の摂動安定性・原点位置ずらし・回転格子・3D Cartesian・高次精度は未検証です。旧1D平面/円筒/球の配布版と判定は変更しません。 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional [-.5,.5]², gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0, T=.6, shock radius.2. Initial conserved states are cell-center cold samples, not exact initial momentum means. All four edges prescribe supersonic inflow rho=1+t/r and u=(-x/r,-y/r). No symmetry boundary, radial projection or geometric source. Adopted numerical method Unsplit shared-face x/y piecewise-constant Rusanov fluxes and SSPRK2/Heun. CFL .35 uses (max a_x+max a_y)/dx. Cold physical outer fluxes are spatially integrated analytically and their affine time dependence is integrated at both Heun stages. No cell repair, pressure floor/seed or hidden timestep retry; invalid stages retain raw arrays and fail. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T∂t​U+∂x​F(U)+∂y​G(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T rs=t/3,(ρ,p,ur)2=(16,16/3,0),(ρ,p,ur)1=(1+t/r,0,−1)rs​=t/3,(ρ,p,ur​)2​=(16,16/3,0),(ρ,p,ur​)1​=(1+t/r,0,−1) ρˉi=1ΔxΔy∫Ciρexact(x2+y2,t) dx dyρˉ​i​=ΔxΔy1​∫Ci​​ρexact​(x2+y2​,t)dxdy M(t)=4R2+8Rtasinh⁡(1)+πt2,Etot=M/2,R=0.5M(t)=4R2+8Rtasinh(1)+πt2,Etot​=M/2,R=0.5 Δt=0.35max⁡ax/Δx+max⁡ay/ΔyΔt=maxax​/Δx+maxay​/Δy0.35​ References and measured quantities Inputs/source/acceptance hashes are saved before execution. All 19 unit tests and 49 gates on three grids passed at the first attempt. Analytic density is integrated over cells by splitting shock-circle cuts and 64-point Gauss quadrature with x=rs sin(theta), checked against 128 points and analytic total mass; these are quadrature references, not closed-form exact cell means. At 128², full-square density L1=.09981, origin-inclusive core L1=.12231; shock errors are.968 axis cells and1.469 diagonal cells. Maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about 4.6e-15. D4 conserved parity and continuous rotational symmetry are measured separately. Verification limits and failures A first-order-space lightweight example retains origin heating and shock errors. Finest maximum center specific internal energy is still about 14% high. Axis/diagonal shock-radius difference is about .501dx and is not monotone over these grids. Roundoff-level D4 parity does not establish exact circular symmetry. General perturbation stability, displaced origins, rotated meshes, 3D Cartesian flow and high-order accuracy are unverified. Earlier planar/cylindrical/spherical 1D editions and gates remain unchanged. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
